stem_md: 曲面 $x\cos z+y\cos x-\frac\pi2z=\frac\pi2$ 在 $(\frac\pi2,1,-\frac\pi2,0)$ 处切平面方程为。
analysis_md:
设 $F(x,y,z)=x\cos z+y\cos x-\frac{\pi}{2}z-\frac{\pi}{2}$，则

$$F_x\left(\frac{\pi}{2},1,-\frac{\pi}{2},0\right)=(\cos z-y\sin x)|_{(\frac{\pi}{2},1,-\frac{\pi}{2},0)}=\frac{\pi}{2},$$

$$F_y\left(\frac{\pi}{2},1,-\frac{\pi}{2},0\right)=\cos x|_{(\frac{\pi}{2},1,-\frac{\pi}{2},0)}=0,$$

$$F_z\left(\frac{\pi}{2},1,-\frac{\pi}{2},0\right)=(-x\sin z-\frac{\pi}{2})|_{(\frac{\pi}{2},1,-\frac{\pi}{2},0)}=-\frac{\pi}{2},$$

切平面方程为：$x-z=\frac{\pi}{2}$。
